WORKFLOW SAMPLES

Here's my samples — inside the automations

A few real builds pulled straight from GoHighLevel and Zapier. Each one shows the actual trigger, the logic branching, and where the data ends up.

GoHighLevel

EDC time-slot form → shuttle & hotel routing → Google Sheets

Guests submit a form with their arrival time slot. The workflow triggers on submission, tags the contact, then checks the notes field to figure out whether they booked a shuttle or a hotel transfer. Each path looks up the matching row and writes the guest's time slot into the correct Google Sheet — so the transport team always has an accurate, live pickup schedule without anyone entering it by hand.

Zapier

Multi-venue event booking → GoHighLevel contact sync

A new booking comes in from the events calendar and immediately splits into six paths — one for each venue (Vegas and Miami locations, including yacht and sunset events). Each path checks its own conditions, formats the booking's date and time correctly, adds a short delay to avoid duplicate processing, then pushes the contact into GoHighLevel via LeadConnector. One booking source, six venues, zero manual sorting.

Zapier

WooCommerce order → shuttle or hotel opportunity

Triggered the moment a customer buys a shuttle or hotel package on WooCommerce. The order splits into two paths based on what was purchased: shuttle orders go straight to creating a GoHighLevel opportunity, while hotel orders first get their date and time formatted before the opportunity is created. Every purchase becomes a trackable opportunity in the CRM automatically — no re-keying order details.

Zapier + AI

Inbox monitoring → AI affiliate detection → CRM update

Watches a Gmail inbox for new emails and splits them based on whether the subject line mentions an affiliate. Affiliate-related emails get passed to an AI step that reads the message and pulls out the relevant data, which then updates the contact in GoHighLevel automatically. Everything else is simply delayed and closed out — so affiliate leads get logged without anyone manually reading every inbox message.
